Initialise a layer in the current directory

Usage: hydragen init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --name <NAME>
          Optional name override (defaults to the current directory name; must not be blank)
      --non-interactive
          Never prompt, even in a terminal
      --author <AUTHOR>
          Optional person or organisation credited with authoring the layer
      --description <DESCRIPTION>
          Optional explanation of what the layer provides or is used for
  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  hydragen init
  hydragen init --name shared-rules
  hydragen init \
    --name shared-agent-rules \
    --author "Example team" \
    --description "Shared agent rules."
  hydragen init --non-interactive

Input:
  No metadata flags: guided prompts only when stdin, stdout and stderr are terminals and CI is
  disabled.
  Any metadata flag: flag-only input; no follow-up questions.
  Name defaults to the current directory name. Author and description are optional and omitted when
  not supplied.
  --non-interactive always disables prompts.

Build projects from shared layers

Usage: hydragen [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init  Initialise a layer in the current directory
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --non-interactive  Never prompt, even in a terminal
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
